title: The new owner sign-in code is tested only half way
what: The tests check the code needs the call tick and works for the owner. They never check that the picked owner of a two-owner gym gets the code, that the owner's old PIN stops working, that a used or older code is refused, or that the new code stays out of the HQ log.
expected: Tests cover the picked owner, the old PIN refused, a code working once, and the code missing from the log.
fix_line: Add the four missing checks to the HQ database test

title: Nothing checks that staff names leave the sign-in history when support access ends
what: The test opens support access and sees names and devices in the sign-in history. It never closes the window and looks again, so names staying on after the window ends would pass.
expected: A test closes the window and checks the history is back to times only.
fix_line: Close the window in the test and check the history again

title: The support view test never checks what a member record shows
what: The test of the read-only support view checks payment and staff records only. The member record, the one that could show Aadhaar or PAN, has no check, so adding such a field would pass unnoticed.
expected: A test checks a member record shows only name, mobile and id.
fix_line: Add a member record to the support view test

title: The web page switch test always says yes and never checks that switching on asks nothing
what: The browser test answers every question with yes, so Cancel is never tried. Its comment says switching on asks no question, but it never checks that no question came.
expected: The test taps Cancel once and checks nothing changed, and checks no question appears when switching on.
fix_line: Add a Cancel step and a no-question check

title: The HQ journey for 3 branches gives the wrong Starter price
what: The journey says 3 branches cost Starter ₹2,497 a month. By the half-price rule it is ₹1,997, which is what HQ shows and what the test checks. Someone testing by the journey would report a fault that is not there.
expected: The journey says Starter ₹1,997 or Pro ₹2,997 for 3 branches.
fix_line: Correct the price in the journey

title: Nothing checks that HQ's private note on a message stays private
what: HQ can write a note on each feedback message that only HQ should see. The feedback tests check the phone address never reaches the page, but no test checks the note stays out of the member and admin apps or survives a status change.
expected: A test checks the note never goes to the apps and is kept when the status changes.
fix_line: Add a note to the feedback test and check both apps' answers
